excluded.Prob099_m2014_q6c: the prompt and testbench use outputs Y2 and Y4, the reference module declares Y1 and Y3, so no candidate (the reference included) can compile with the testbench

dataset.testbench_patch: removed the waveform-dump block ($dumpfile/$dumpvars): it refers to `tb_mismatch` before its declaration, which Icarus Verilog 14 rejects ('Unable to bind wire/reg/memory'); it writes a VCD and has no effect on the mismatch count
